topic.topicDisplayName: Belimumab and anifrolumab in SLE: mechanism, indications, trial data
topic.coverageNote: Stored abstract of an indirect comparison of the two biologics, including indication differences, SRI-4, steroid taper, herpes zoster, and lupus nephritis uncertainty. Molecular mechanism is not described in the abstract, so it is not questioned.

mcqs.question: How does this indirect comparison describe regulatory indications?

options.A: Belimumab is approved for SLE and lupus nephritis; anifrolumab is not currently approved for lupus nephritis
options.B: Both are approved for lupus nephritis
options.D: Anifrolumab is approved only for lupus nephritis and not for SLE

mcqs.explanation: The abstract says belimumab is approved for both SLE and lupus nephritis, whereas anifrolumab is not currently approved for lupus nephritis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Belimumab is approved for both SLE and lupus nephritis (LN), whereas anifrolumab is not currently approved for LN

mcqs.question: What SRI-4 result does the indirect comparison report for belimumab relative to anifrolumab in SLE?

options.B: Odds ratio 0.31 favouring belimumab on SRI-4
options.D: Anifrolumab was superior on SRI-4 with a CI excluding 1

mcqs.explanation: The abstract says belimumab demonstrated superior SRI-4 response rates, OR 1.99, 95% CI 1.25–3.16, relative to anifrolumab.

sourceRefs.excerpt: belimumab demonstrated superior SRI‑4 response rates (OR = 1.99, 95% CI: 1.25-3.16) relative to anifrolumab

mcqs.question: On corticosteroid tapering, which agent did the indirect comparison favour?

options.B: Belimumab, with the same OR used for SRI-4

mcqs.explanation: The abstract says anifrolumab yielded greater benefit in steroid tapering, OR 0.31, 95% CI 0.19–0.51.

sourceRefs.excerpt: anifrolumab yielded greater benefit in steroid tapering (OR = 0.31, 95% CI: 0.19-0.51)

mcqs.question: What safety difference does the abstract report?

options.A: Serious infections and mortality were similar, but anifrolumab was linked to more herpes zoster (7.2% vs 3.2–4.6%)
options.B: Belimumab had more herpes zoster in this text
options.C: Anifrolumab had excess mortality as the main finding

mcqs.explanation: The abstract says safety was similar for serious infections and mortality, although anifrolumab was linked to higher rates of herpes zoster, 7.2% versus 3.2–4.6% for belimumab.

sourceRefs.excerpt: anifrolumab was linked to higher rates of herpes zoster (7.2% vs. 3.2-4.6% for belimumab)

mcqs.question: What does the abstract conclude about complete renal response in lupus nephritis?

options.A: Both agents improved complete renal response versus placebo, but the indirect comparison was not definitive because the confidence interval was wide
options.B: Belimumab was clearly superior with a narrow CI
options.C: Anifrolumab is approved for lupus nephritis on this result

mcqs.explanation: The abstract says both agents improved complete renal response versus placebo, but the indirect comparison was not definitive because of a wide confidence interval (OR 0.83, 95% CI 0.22–3.10).

sourceRefs.excerpt: indirect comparisons between the two agents were not definitive due to wide confidence intervals (CRR: OR = 0.83, 95% CI: 0.22-3.10)
